note: BLM Lander Field Office campground in a semi-alpine conifer setting on Green Mountain, ~10.5 mi S of US 287 via Green Mountain Rd (BLM 2411, improved gravel), E of Jeffrey City. The Green Mountain Loop Road above the campground is open June 15 - December 1. --Claude
summary: BLM page: confirmed 18 sites, $20 FCFS (no rec.gov listing; $10 with Senior/Access pass), 14-day limit, June 1-Oct 31, water + accessible vault toilets, 'can accommodate large recreational vehicles'. The 2025 culvert failure (trailers barred June 2025) was fixed: BLM reopened the campground July 3, 2026, so the note's caveat is dropped. Pin ~230 m S of BLM's point; loops not legible on snow-covered imagery.
flags: Note caveat removed as outdated: 'A 2025 culvert failure temporarily limited trailer access - verify road status before towing.' BLM, July 2, 2026: 'The Bureau of Land Management is pleased to announce the completion of the Cottonwood Campground Culvert Replacement Project. Cottonwood Campground will reopen on July 3, 2026.'

Pin: stored 42.36030,-107.68470 sits ~230 m S of BLM's published point 42.3624,-107.68456. Esri imagery is snow-covered and the campground spurs can't be made out, so no imagery-based move; BLM's point is the better candidate if one is wanted.

Phone 307-332-8400 confirmed (BLM Lander Field Office). Directions on the BLM page: from Jeffrey City go east 6.3 miles to Green Mountain Road, then about 10.5 miles south (the stored note said '~10 mi S of Jeffrey City'; corrected).
